responsibility: Implements the split-paths optimization pass that duplicates join blocks on paths to loop latches. It looks for a specific if-then-else diamond feeding a latch, checks dominance, CFG simplicity, statement-count and if-conversion profitability heuristics, then duplicates the join block into predecessor paths while preserving SSA, creating larger straight-line traces that can expose CSE, DCE, jump-threading, and branch simplification opportunities in loops.
